long_biography.plain_text:
The division of an earlier dealership group in 2010 put David Gerbier in control of Fiat and Citroën businesses in Rhône-Alpes. It also created Groupe DG8 as a vehicle for further expansion. He gave operating managers equity alongside the holding company, linking local responsibility with an acquisition-led strategy.

Gerbier had opened a Fiat and Range Rover agency in 1984 and became a Fiat concessionaire two years later, at 27. He broadened the group across manufacturers and regions through purchases of dealership businesses. The portfolio later shifted away from some traditional car franchises and further into motorhomes and campervans. DG8's leisure-vehicle network became a major part of the business, while the remaining car dealerships continue to sell and service several marques.
